title: Chargeback History Scale on Returned Chargeback Fees, Northloop Payments
content:
**Rule.** The chargeback fee money returned on a won Northloop Payments chargeback case is scaled by the chargeback history multiplier. The chargeback history multiplier is 0.5 when at least 3 chargebacks were debited to the account in the last twelve months, counting the won case, 0.75 when exactly 2 were, and 1 when the won case is the only one.

A window of the last twelve months takes in the ledger entries dated after the same calendar day twelve months before the return date, up to and including the return date. The chargebacks counted are the chargeback debits booked on the account's ledger in that window.

| Chargebacks debited to the account in the last twelve months, the won case included | Chargeback history multiplier |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 0.5 |
| exactly 2 | 0.75 |
| 1 (the won case only) | 1 |

*Hypothetical cases.* The won case plus one other chargeback debited five months before the return date: 2 chargebacks, multiplier 0.75. The won case plus another debited fourteen months before: the other lies outside the window, so the multiplier is 1.
